question: What is the seed interval of posteriordb v7's oWALNUTS / CmdStan min-bulk-ESS-per-gradient geomean over the fixed 16 models (v7: 0.708 on 15/16 complete, 3 seeds)?
commit_note: main c5c60122. Relative to the v7 commit f097391c its library adds only documentation, WP59 chain-warning reporting and the research-feature-gated, default-None WarmupConfig::with_initial_phase_max_depth (WP57), so the default sampler and its draws are those of f097391c. The worktree was fast-forwarded to c5c60122; the driver checks src/, integrations/, tests/ and Cargo.toml against it.

arms.owalnuts: v7 harness unchanged: Sampler::new() with only the run shape (4 chains, 1,000/1,000, seed, 4 threads) and admit_worst_case; every default from the commit (best_of(16) starts, RejectLeaf, adaptive diagonal, no rescue)
arms.cmdstan: CmdStan 2.39.0 via cmdstanpy 1.3.0 at defaults, four parallel chains; the v7 executables (copied from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/models/cmdstan)

models_source: BridgeStan libraries and CmdStan executables copied from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/models
seeds_verified_unused: git grep -w over every tracked file of the worktree at c5c60122 found none of 620601-620603
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts then cmdstan; seeds ascending; strictly sequential (v6/v7 model/arm/seed order)
parameter_set: posteriordb reference-draw columns (all 16 have reference draws); ArviZ 0.23.4; reference z on every cell
statistic: v7's: per model and arm the seed median of min bulk ESS / gradients_total; ratio owalnuts / cmdstan; geometric mean over included models

inclusion_rule.text: 3-seed analyses (new seeds alone; v7 recomputed) use v7's rule: a model is included only if all three seeds are status ok on both arms. The 6-seed pooled geomean includes a model if both arms have at least 5 of 6 ok cells (median over the ok cells); each leave-one-seed-out geomean (5 seeds) requires at least 4 of 5. The number of included models is reported with every geomean.

analysis.new_three: per-model ratios and geomean on the three new seeds alone
analysis.pooled_six: per-model ratios and geomean over v7's 3 seeds plus the 3 new seeds (v7 cells read unchanged from STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7/artifacts/cells)
analysis.seed_interval: leave-one-seed-out range of the pooled geomean: drop each of the six seeds in turn (both arms), recompute, report [min, max] and its width
analysis.passes: house gates per arm: new seeds /48, v7 seeds /48, pooled /96
analysis.z_check: every passing owalnuts cell's max |z| against 4, new and pooled
analysis.single_seed: geomean of each seed alone (descriptive), used for the seed-count recommendation

seed_count_recommendation.primary: jackknife over the six leave-one-seed-out pooled geomeans g_i: SE_jk = sqrt((k-1)/k * sum (g_i - mean g)^2), k = 6; assuming SE scales as sqrt(6/n), recommend n = ceil(6 (2 SE_jk / 0.05)^2) seeds, the count for which an approximate 95% interval of the seed-median geomean has half-width 0.05 on the ratio scale (the margin that matters for a 0.75 gate)
seed_count_recommendation.reported: also n = ceil((2 SD / 0.05)^2) from the log-scale SD of the six single-seed geomeans; single-seed geomeans are dominated by competitor stuck chains (a one-seed median cannot absorb them), so this is reported, not primary

Q3.text: the leave-one-seed-out range is wider than 0.08

Q4.text: owalnuts passes >= 40/48 on the new seeds

decision_rule: Attribution and reporting only; no default flips. Report whether the pooled 6-seed geomean clears 0.75 (the v6/v7 P3 threshold) and recommend a seed count for future per-gradient release gates from the observed variation (seed_count_recommendation). v7's verdict is not rewritten; its README gains one paragraph citing this extension.
rules: No reruns; failures are results; walls contended (machine quieter than in v7) and not evidence.
